# ankra_clusters (Data Source)

Lists the clusters visible to the authenticated Ankra token, in the provider's project, or in the project `project_id` names.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_clusters" "all" {}

output "cluster_names" {
  value = [for cluster in data.ankra_clusters.all.clusters : cluster.name]
}

# The clusters of another project, by slug or ID, without changing the
# provider's own project.
data "ankra_clusters" "staging" {
  project_id = "staging"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `ankra_token` (String, Sensitive, Deprecated) Deprecated per-data-source API token. Configure the token on the provider block (or the ANKRA_TOKEN environment variable) instead of per resource.
- `project_id` (String) List the clusters of this project (its ID or slug) instead of the provider's project. The platform shows a cluster only in its own project, so this is how to read another project's clusters from one provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `clusters` (Attributes List) Clusters returned by the platform. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--clusters))
- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source.

<a id="nestedatt--clusters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `clusters`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Identifier of the cluster.
- `name` (String) Name of the cluster.
- `project_id` (String) ID of the project the cluster belongs to: the project the listing ran in. Null when neither the data source nor the provider names a project.
